title: 第9章 一招击败

content_zh:
结果没想到，现在被打脸的却是他们自己，傻眼了的都是他们自己。
当然，很多人是不会承认的，反正我没压过穆振飞胜，我一直都是觉得狄明能胜利的。
只有高宏志丝毫不在意自己看走眼了这个事实，连忙问道：“云凡，你怎么知道狄明会胜利，之前我可是一点都没有看出穆振飞下盘不稳呢！”
许多人的目光也都同时扫了过来，他们都竖起了耳朵，他们其实也想听听到底是为什么，最好是楚云凡瞎猫碰上死耗子，否则全部人都猜错了，只有他一个人猜对了，岂不是好尴尬啊。
楚云凡忽然发现，在圆圈的对面，正是唐思雨，此时连唐思雨的一双亮晶晶的美眸都落到了他的身上，眼神之中带着几分好奇，似乎也想知道答案。
而在他的斜对面，班级里的另外一个风云人物，冯德英则是看着脸色有几分不善的样子，虽然很快收敛了，不过楚云凡还是敏锐的察觉到了。
楚云凡顿了顿，然后开口说道：“穆振飞的下盘其实还没有不稳到那个地步，只是狄明刚好擅长腿功，所以我才这么说的！”
众人有些恍然的样子，不过怎么听着都像是走了狗—屎运了，刚好就注意到了这一点，如果他们早就注意到的话，也就没有这个家伙出风头的余地了。
连狄明都是满脸笑容的看了过来，至于他刚才有没有是因为楚云凡的话才半途中想起来猛攻穆振飞的下盘，那也就只有他自己知道了。
不过楚云凡话音刚落，一道身影就已经气势汹汹的冲了过来了，却不是穆振飞又是谁，和满脸笑容的胜利者狄明不同，穆振飞输掉了这一次切磋，却是极为愤怒。
“楚云凡，有本事的你别光—逼—逼，是爷们的咱上来打一架！”显然穆振飞也听到了楚云凡的话，如果他赢了，那不过都是小事，偏偏他输了，他就成了楚云凡那一番装逼的话的背景。
“怎么着？输不起啊，刚才还说爷们呢？”楚云凡还没有说话，高宏志就已经站了出来了。“你自己输了，还怪场外的人啊！”
“高宏志，这事儿和你没关系，楚云凡，我就问你，敢不敢来！”穆振飞被高宏志给逼退了一步，虽然高宏志看起来高高胖胖的，但是谁不知道班级里他是最不好惹的人之一。
不过他心中的怒气还是让他再度问道。
“诶，高宏志，同学间的切磋而已，你这么紧张干什么！”此时，不知道什么时候，冯德英已经来到了场中，隐隐挡住了高宏志。
“大班长！”高宏志看着冯德英，大班长三个字咬重音说道。“这里又有你什么事儿了，怎么着，咱俩也来搭搭手？”
面对班长冯德英，高宏志丝毫不让，虽然一个是班级男神，一个则是段子手死胖子，但是熟悉十一班情况的都知道，两人是班中男生的佼佼者，难免相互较劲。
谁也不服输！
“高宏志，你也别来劲，我就是就事论事，同学之间切磋一下怎么了，楚云凡都没说话呢，你冒出来算怎么回事儿？”冯德英脸上带着几分嘲讽的神情开口说道。
他的话，将所有人的注意力都转向了楚云凡这边。

似乎都想知道，他敢不敢出手，所有人都知道楚云凡其实天赋一般，穆振飞还有希望能够考上武科班，但是楚云凡是铁定没机会了。
只差一个月了，而他还只是肉身境第五重的修为，相差两重，一个月的时间太短了。
“来就来呗，既然你都这么说了！”楚云凡站了起来，说道。
他发现，自己居然在隐隐的兴奋，如果是以往的话，他肯定不会接下这种莫名其妙的挑战的。
他们家的家境决定了，他玩不起实战游戏，虽然实战进步的快，但是伤一次，那治疗费用，可就足够心疼的了。
但是现在，突破之后，他居然隐隐在兴奋。
“好，还算你是个爷们！”穆振飞见楚云凡同意了，脸上露出了几分狰狞的神情，他要将刚才败北的怒火全部宣泄在楚云凡的身上，让他知道，有些话不能乱说。
“你真的没问题吧？”高宏志有些不放心的说道。
“放心，多大点事儿，不就是切磋么！”楚云凡点点头，说道。
两人准备就绪之后，众人也都离开了切磋的区域。

content_en:
Unexpectedly, it was they who were slapped in the face now, and they were the ones who were dumbfounded.
Of course, many people will not admit it. Anyway, I have not defeated Mu Zhenfei. I have always thought that Di Ming can win.
Only Gao Hongzhi didn't care at all about the fact that he had made a mistake and asked quickly: "Yunfan, how did you know that Di Ming would win? I didn't notice that Mu Zhenfei was unstable at all before!"
Many people's eyes also glanced over at the same time. They all pricked up their ears. They actually wanted to hear the reason. It would be best for Chu Yunfan to be a blind cat and a dead mouse, otherwise everyone would guess wrong and he would be the only one to guess right. Wouldn't it be embarrassing?
Chu Yunfan suddenly discovered that on the opposite side of the circle was Tang Siyu. At this time, even Tang Siyu's shining eyes fell on him. There was a bit of curiosity in his eyes, and he seemed to want to know the answer.
Diagonally opposite him, Feng Deying, another influential figure in the class, looked a little unkind. Although he quickly calmed down, Chu Yunfan was still keenly aware of it.
Chu Yunfan paused, and then said: "Mu Zhenfei's lower body is actually not that unstable, but Di Ming happens to be good at leg skills, so that's why I said that!"
Everyone looked a little stunned, but it sounded like they were just lucky enough to notice this. If they had noticed it a long time ago, there would be no room for this guy to stand out.
Even Di Ming looked over with a smile on his face. As for whether he thought of attacking Mu Zhenfei's lower plate just now because of Chu Yunfan's words, only he knew.
However, as soon as Chu Yunfan finished speaking, a figure rushed over aggressively, but it was not Mu Zhenfei. Unlike Di Ming, the winner with a smile on his face, Mu Zhenfei lost this competition, but he was extremely angry.
"Chu Yunfan, if you have the ability, don't just force me. Let's come and fight!" Apparently Mu Zhenfei also heard Chu Yunfan's words. If he won, it would be nothing more than a trivial matter. However, if he lost, he would become the background of Chu Yunfan's pretentious words.
"What's the matter? You can't afford to lose, and you were talking about men just now?" Before Chu Yunfan could speak, Gao Hongzhi had already stood up. "You lost yourself, and you blame the people outside the field!"
"Gao Hongzhi, this matter has nothing to do with you. Chu Yunfan, I'm just asking you, do you dare to come?" Mu Zhenfei was forced to take a step back by Gao Hongzhi. Although Gao Hongzhi looked tall and fat, who didn't know that he was one of the most difficult people to mess with in the class.
However, the anger in his heart still made him ask again.
"Hey, Gao Hongzhi, it's just a competition between classmates, why are you so nervous!" At this time, Feng Deying had already arrived at the field, vaguely blocking Gao Hongzhi.
"Supervisor!" Gao Hongzhi looked at Feng Deying and said with emphasis on the word "supervisor". "What's the matter with you here again? What's going on, why don't we come and help each other?"
Facing class monitor Feng Deying, Gao Hongzhi refused to give in at all. Although one was the idol of the class and the other was a fat guy who was good at jokes, anyone familiar with Class 11 knew that the two were the best boys in the class and it was inevitable that they would compete with each other.
No one admits defeat!
"Gao Hongzhi, don't get too excited. I'm just discussing the matter. Let's discuss what's going on among classmates. Chu Yunfan didn't say anything. What's going on with you coming out?" Feng Deying said with a somewhat mocking look on his face.
His words turned everyone's attention to Chu Yunfan.
Everyone seemed to want to know if he dared to take action. Everyone knew that Chu Yunfan actually had average talent. Mu Zhenfei still had hope of being admitted to the martial arts class, but Chu Yunfan definitely had no chance.
There is only one month left, and he is only at the fifth level of physical realm., the difference is twofold, one month is too short.
"Come just come, since you said so!" Chu Yunfan stood up and said.
He found that he was actually feeling faintly excited. If it were the past, he would definitely not accept such an inexplicable challenge.
Due to their family's financial situation, he couldn't afford to play actual combat games. Although he made rapid progress in actual combat, the cost of treatment for one injury would be heartbreaking enough.
But now, after the breakthrough, he was actually faintly excited.
"Okay, you are a man!" Seeing that Chu Yunfan agreed, Mu Zhenfei showed a ferocious look on his face. He wanted to vent all the anger of his defeat on Chu Yunfan, letting him know that some things should not be said carelessly.
"Are you really okay?" Gao Hongzhi said with some worry.
"Don't worry, no matter how big the deal, it's just a discussion!" Chu Yunfan nodded and said.
After the two were ready, everyone left the sparring area.
